name: Telenor ASA
summary: Telenor ASA, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a telecommunication company worldwide. It operates through four segments: Nordics, Asia, Infrastructure, and Amp. The company offers mobile and broadband telecom products and services, including mobile, broadband and TV services; other services, including solutions for business customers like managed services, virtual private networks, software defined networks, and network as a service; IoT solutions; and mobile maritime communication for cruise and ferry, fisheries, and oil and gas industry.
